master:
Refine the attached Quiet Order moodboard into ONE polished design-input candidate version, not a new direction. Landscape 1536 x 1024. Preserve the warm ivory, deep burgundy, matte ceramic and cotton visual language, the asymmetric editorial layout and the abstract ivory/burgundy folded-loop AI form. Keep title "Quiet Order" and Chinese "温暖有序". Refined calmer art direction, fewer decorative slogans, stronger readable typography, generous purposeful spacing. Do not change to a cold blue or peach style. The board is for a North American postpartum mother care assistant with strict priority: reliable practical assistance > respectful support > clear guidance. It does not diagnose.
Specific improvements:
1. Remove duplicate decorative slogans in the photos, handwritten text and any unsubstantiated color-psychology words. Keep one large beautiful cotton + shallow matte ceramic image, a close-up texture tile, and soft daylight tile. These are visual inspiration only.
2. Five original swatches with exact labels and hex: Burgundy #692A3A / Action; Ivory #FAF7F2 / Canvas; Oat #E9DED4 / Accent; Sage #DCE5DE / Accent; Ink #282725 / Text. Add a very small secondary-text specimen labeled "#625B57". Darken all explanatory body copy so it remains readable; no faint grey text.
3. Typography area: "Montserrat" heading specimen; "System sans" body specimen; clear small labels "Title 24/32 · Body 16/24 · Supporting 14/20". Use plain legible sans body. English app content, Chinese only board title/subtitle. No need for alphabet dump.
4. Right-side mobile content sample is a simple flat content rectangle at natural 390x844 proportions, no phone bezel, OS statusbar, notch, device shadow or rounded outer hardware. Avoid nested cards. Exact text: "Momcozy AI", small "AI assistant"; heading "Review your entry"; rows labeled "Type" with "Bottle feed", "Amount" with "3 fl oz", "Time" with "Today, 10:30 AM". Rows have NO arrows, NO individual edit buttons. Under rows small "Not saved yet". One dominant solid burgundy button "Save entry". ONE secondary text action "Edit" beneath it. Bottom sentence "You can update this later." All body text dark and readable. Tiny 32px folded-loop symbol in header, not a giant character. Below app: "Concept · sample data".
5. AI study area show the same small mature abstract folded loop at two scales, with text "Quiet presence. Clear feedback." and "Form study — not a final character". No faces, eyes, mouths, limbs, human doctor, baby, medical uniform, robot face, glow or rainbow. Do not claim exact finished small-size production readiness.
6. Top/left short intent "Practical help, thoughtfully delivered." Keywords "Capable · Clear · Considerate". Footer exactly "QO-1.0 · Candidate design input · Pending review · Not an official brand guide".
Everything fits neatly, no clipping. Exact tokens are concept specification, raster colors need not be claimed measured. Prioritize mature useful interface over ornament. This is the same selected direction, refined.
states:
Create a companion INTERACTION EXPRESSION BOARD for the attached selected "Quiet Order / 温暖有序" moodboard. This is a focused component/state study, not another style option or full product screen. Landscape 1536 x 1024. Clear beautiful editorial design, warm ivory #FAF7F2, white panels, burgundy #692A3A for primary actions, dark #282725 body and #625B57 supporting copy. Same small ivory and burgundy matte folded-loop AI form; no face. No photos needed. Text is crisp and comfortably readable, purposeful whitespace. Title "Quiet Order — State language"; small Chinese subtitle "温暖有序 · 状态与反馈". Footer "QO-1.0 · Candidate design input · Sample states, not a complete flow".
Two distinct rows / sections, NOT one continuous timeline:
TOP section "RECORD TASK" with FOUR horizontally aligned component studies. Label each:
"Review": show small neutral text "Not saved yet", minimal summary "Bottle feed · 3 fl oz", primary "Save entry", secondary "Edit".
"Saving": text "Saving entry…", simple tiny progress indicator, noninteractive muted button "Saving…". Not a fabricated percentage. No success check.
"Saved": clearly legible check icon plus text "Entry saved", secondary "Edit". No celebration confetti, praise or health validation.
"Save failed": visible error icon plus "Couldn’t save.", support "Your entry is still here.", primary "Try again", secondary "Edit". Error text #9C3E34 on light #FBEDE9, only this actual failure uses red.
BOTTOM section "UNDERSTANDING TASK" with TWO wider components separated from top row:
"Analyzing": tiny folded-loop identity and text "Reviewing your recording…"; a modest static indicator for a motion storyboard, no progress percentage or time promise.
"Unable to determine": tiny static folded-loop identity, neutral information icon, exact text "This recording isn’t enough to identify a cause." No red or green, no checkmark, no diagnosis, no retry button, no invented follow-up feature. Supporting text "No conclusion from this recording." This is an honest uncertainty state, NOT a system error.
Beside or below bottom components, a narrow notes panel "Presence rules" with only 3 short lines: "Still by default", "Text carries the status", "No automatic sound". A small design note "Input / button radius 12 · Content radius 16 · Button height 48". The shape does not morph to a new identity. No anthropomorphic expression or constant decorative motion. Colors should feel related to the reference. Do not add a phone, dates, navigation, score, dashboard, medical advice or unrelated fields. The board is visual expression specifications; app body16/24 and supporting14/20 are candidate targets, clearly legible here. Use exact source text as much as possible.
